project_type: Node.js npm package for SAP CAP, uses XState for state machines
build_system: npm, no explicit build step - raw JS files
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm test to verify all tests pass. 2. For examples, cd into each example directory and run npm install && cds mbt run to verify they work.
contribution_requirements: Follow Conventional Commits format. Use ES6+ features. Add JSDoc comments for public APIs. Follow existing code patterns. No unused dependencies. Run npm test before committing.

key_patterns.file_structure: lib/ contains main code, bin/ has CLI entry, templates/ for scaffolding, test/ for tests, examples/ for complete mini-projects
key_patterns.code_style: Use semicolons, JSDoc comments with @param/@returns, require() for imports, module.exports for exports
key_patterns.module_pattern: Each module has an index.js that re-exports submodules. Functions use object destructuring for options.
key_patterns.invariant_pattern: Use createInvariant() with name, description, check function returning {passed, message}
key_patterns.machine_pattern: Use xstate createMachine() with context, guards, actions defined separately
key_patterns.cli_integration: cds-plugin.js registers CLI commands via cds.cli.commands object

directory_structure.lib/: Main source code - index.js entry point, core/ for engine, cli/ for commands, invariants/ for built-ins, machines/ for templates
directory_structure.templates/: Scaffolding templates used by 'cds mbt init' (to be created)
directory_structure.examples/: Complete mini CAP projects demonstrating usage (to be created)
